_comment: Paths the Evolution Engine's builder agent (Rung 3) may NEVER modify, regardless of a proposal's declared scopePaths. Enforced in CI by scripts/check-protected-paths.mjs, which fails-closed. Editing this file is itself a human-only PR (it lives under .github, which is protected). Spec: ASSEMBLY_PAGE_SPEC.md section 7.3.
_tokenComment: Files carrying token credit/claim/ledger logic. The token model is sacred (STEERING section 5); the machine never writes tokens.
_drizzleComment: Under drizzle/, a NEW migration that only CREATEs tables or ADDs columns or INSERTs seed rows is allowed. Any migration touching existing structure (DROP, ALTER ... MODIFY/CHANGE/DROP, TRUNCATE, RENAME, DELETE, UPDATE of live data) is rejected. Enforced by content scan in the checker.
